ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first rural marketplace and direct procurement platform matching local farmers with institutional buyers.
ideas.title: KrishiLink
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets rural supply chain inefficiencies, a major local pain point, and adopts the multilingual accessibility pattern proven by SAGACITY.

ideas.pitch: A browser extension and API gateway detecting zero-day phishing scams and malicious link injections targeting regional banking users.
ideas.title: PhishGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-stakes digital trust for local financial users, addressing an acute security challenge that judges instantly understand.

ideas.pitch: An automated energy audit and waste monitoring platform for institutional campuses using computer vision and IoT analytics.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies concrete environmental impact metrics directly to campus infrastructure, fitting the exact venue and sustainability track criteria.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first multilingual document intelligence extractor that converts unstructured medical records into structured electronic health profiles.
ideas.title: DocuPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages localized multimodal extraction to solve real healthcare administrative friction, mirroring the winning recipe of LibrAI.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight predictive dashboard forecasting localized water contamination risks using seasonal sensor inputs and machine learning.
ideas.title: AquaPredict
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the predictive environmental monitoring success of iForeSea by offering clear, measurable risk metrics within a compact dashboard.
